zh: 两数之和能否被 x 整除，只取决于它们除以 x 的余数：r1+r2 ≡ 0 (mod x)。
从左到右扫描，处理 j 时只和它之前的商品配对，这样每一对恰好统计一次，也不会让商品和自己配对。
用哈希表记录已见过的余数次数：对每个价格令 r=p mod x，先把余数 (x−r) mod x 的次数加进答案，再把 r 的次数加一；x 可达 2×10^9，不能开长度为 x 的数组；答案用 64 位。
en: Whether two prices sum to a multiple of x depends only on their remainders mod x: r1+r2 ≡ 0 (mod x).
Scan left to right and pair j only with earlier items; every pair is then counted exactly once and no item is paired with itself.

Keep a hash map of the remainder counts seen so far: for each price, with r = p mod x, first add the count of (x−r) mod x to the answer, then increment the count of r. x can reach 2×10^9, so no array of length x; use a 64-bit answer.

explanationEn:
## Approach

While scanning, first add the frequency of the complementary remainder among earlier items, then increment the count of the current remainder.

## Proof of correctness

The sum is divisible by x exactly when the two remainders are complementary. When j is scanned, the table contains only items with i<j, so adding the frequency of the complement counts exactly all valid pairs whose right end is j; different j never repeat a pair, so the answer is exact and no item is paired with itself.

## Complexity

Expected O(n) time and O(min(n,x)) space, using a sparse dictionary instead of an array of length x.
